grammar_focus: 复习 KS15/39/63 间接引语(方案B换情节包):直接引语变间接引语时的时态后移、say that / tell sb that 的区别、一般疑问用 ask if/whether、特殊疑问用 ask + 疑问词并改陈述语序;附语域注(口语转述当下仍成立的事时态可不后移)
scene: 昨天,一位记者就那场大赛采访了我们的教练。她问他球队是怎么备战的。他说他们那一个月一直在刻苦训练。他告诉她,队员们都准备好了,信心十足。记者问明星球员会不会上场。他说她状态很好,肯定会打。她问比赛几点开始。他告诉她当晚七点开赛。他还补充说,希望球迷们都来加油助威。后来,记者写道,这位教练听上去非常乐观。

grammar_card.title: 复习 KS15/39/63 间接引语
grammar_card.intro: 把别人的话转述出来,就是间接引语。要点:①时态后移——主句是过去时(said/told/asked)时,从句里的现在→过去、现在完成→过去完成、will→would(He said they had been training / the players were ready);②say 与 tell 的区别——tell 后面要跟人(told her that…),say 后面不直接跟人(said that…);③一般疑问的转述用 ask if / whether(asked whether she would play);④特殊疑问的转述用 ask + 疑问词,且从句改成陈述语序、不倒装(asked when the game would start,不是 when would the game start)。

rows: He said that… / He told her that…
"They are ready" → He said they were ready.
"Will she play?" → She asked whether she would play.
特殊疑问 ask + 疑问词(陈述语序)
"When does it start?" → She asked when it started.

specialRules.rule: 美语“足球场”常说 field(英式 pitch);“电影”说 movie(英式 film)。本课已按美语写。
tell 后面必须跟人(told her that…),say 后面不直接跟人(said that…);特殊疑问转述后从句用陈述语序,不倒装。
语域注:口语里转述“当下仍成立”的事,时态可以不后移(He said the team is ready 也自然);正式书面则一般后移(was ready)。本课按正式书面的后移作答。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Who did the reporter interview?

passage: Yesterday a reporter asked our coach about the big game. She asked him how the team had prepared. He said that they had been training hard all month. He told her that the players were ready and confident. The reporter asked whether the star player would join the match. He said that she was feeling great and would definitely play. She asked when the game would start. He told her that it would begin at seven that evening. He added that he hoped the fans would come and cheer. Later, the reporter wrote that the coach sounded very positive.

grammar_points.name: 间接引语的时态后移(are→were / has→had)
say that 与 tell sb that 的区别
一般疑问的转述 ask if / whether

间接引语综合(will→would / 疑问词后移)
